analyst_view.overall: Early view: in-form Heerenveen host Cambuur in a Frisian derby. Heerenveen won five in a row including the 5-3 against Feyenoord, with eredivisie.nl crediting their defence for the rise; Cambuur's Johan Plat was October's Coach of the Month, but Cambuur lost 5-2 at home to PSV and, by one report, are without captain Amofa for the rest of the season.

goals.text: The numbers say 4 goals. I lean lower: Heerenveen's run has been built on defence (a 1-0 win over NEC before the Feyenoord game), and Cambuur without their captain may struggle to keep up with Heerenveen's pace.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.7 corners, mostly Heerenveen's. That fits a home side in form, and I see no reason to move.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.3 cards. I lean a touch higher because this is a Frisian derby, and Cambuur's game with PSV showed how heated their fans can make things.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.6 shots. Heerenveen's attack, with Ringo Meerveld in form, should produce most of them, which matches the split.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.8 shots on target. Heerenveen's finishing is sharp, but Cambuur's attack will be weaker without Amofa; I keep it.
